title: Adessive Pronouns: At My Place / On My Person

sections.content:
The adessive case (*-nál / -nél*, meaning 'at' or 'by') forms personal pronouns with the stem **nál-**:
- **nálam** = at my place / on me (with me)
- **nálad** = at your place / on you
- **nála** = at his/her place / with him/her
- **nálunk** = at our place / with us
- **nálatok** = at your (pl) place / with you all
- **náluk** = at their place / with them

items.english: I have the apartment key on me.
We are having dinner at our place tonight.
Do you have cash on you?
